extension.description: Run the opencode v2 TUI inside VS Code and inject the current file or selection as an @path#Lx-Ly reference
config.binary: Command used to launch the TUI. Accepts a full path or flags, for example opencode --standalone
config.terminalName: Terminal name used to decide whether to reuse an existing session. Keeping the default lets it reuse a terminal you opened yourself
config.injectOnLaunch: Also inject the current file reference when creating a new terminal. Off by default: characters sent before the TUI takes over input can be executed by the shell
